chunks: (Nor make friends with) those who, when you call (the faithful) to prayer, make mock of it and jest, because they do not understand.

key_terms.الصَّلاَةِ: Prayer (specifically the ritual prayer or its call)

ai.seo_question: Why do hypocrites mock the call to prayer according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the superficiality of the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who reduce the sacred Adhan to mere entertainment, reflecting a deeper spiritual blindness. The phrase 'a people who do not use their intellect' (la ya'qilun) is interpreted not as a lack of cognitive ability, but as a failure to apply reason to recognize the divine reality behind the ritual. This critique underscores the necessity of aligning outward worship with inward conviction, a key theme in understanding the nature of true faith versus performative piety.
